study: CWRU application of blockwise occupancy inference
protocol_status: Specified before evaluating fault signals; CWRU was selected after normal-reference screening. This is not an externally preregistered study. The evaluation grid was clarified to the manuscript stride before fault signals were evaluated.
primary_cohort: 48 kHz drive-end acceleration: healthy loads 0,1,2,3 hp and IR, ball, centred OR defects of 0.007,0.014,0.021 inches at each load (36 fault conditions)
additional_cohort: All available 48 kHz drive-end outer-race positions 3 and 12 o'clock (16 conditions)
preprocessing: No filtering, resampling, per-file normalization, synthetic anomalies or concatenation. Standardize each load using its healthy fitting segment only. Preserve original sample order and the exact named DE array.

primary_design.evaluation_stride_rule: five micro-scores (5*r), as in the manuscript monitoring grid

diagnostic: Gaussian working CHARN location score with mean basis (1,x,x exp(-x^2/2)) and variance basis (1,x^2), intercept truncated below at 0.1 and nonnegative variance slope, as in the manuscript simulation. Fit and pointwise cutoff remain frozen during count calibration and evaluation.
additional_comparison: Randomized-tie rank calibration at a common nominal 0.01 level for the six underlying statistics, using a fixed seed. A direct count and record count cannot differ once the same final count rule is imposed.
sensitivity_designs: Student-t5 working score with standardized innovations
spaced evaluation with stride equal to full raw support plus calibration gap; reproduces the earlier normal-only screen
record_sensitivity: Fixed Yang-Nevzorov growth factors gamma=1,1.02,1.05,1.10,1.25, without selecting a winner on fault results.
reporting: Exact per-record block counts and proportions; equal-weight averages over the 36 primary conditions; all 16 additional conditions reported separately. No point adjustment, no binomial standard errors for dependent blocks, and no claim of independent physical replication.
scope: No numerical beta-mixing envelope is established by these data. Nominal rank budgets are not asserted as certified field error probabilities. Known bearing state is not a physical short-versus-persistent event annotation; no duration confidence set or onset-delay estimate is claimed.

subsequent_audit.basis: Smith and Randall (2015), Table 3: literature-motivated acquisition-quality sensitivity added after the primary run, with no model or threshold refitting. All primary recordings retained in headline results.
